description: Replace the content of an existing page in place: the same URL serves the new content immediately, so links the human already shared keep working. Use this instead of publish_page whenever the page already exists. The previous version stays restorable from the dashboard for 7 days (Pro keeps full version history). Pass draft: true to stage the update instead: nothing changes for viewers until the maker reviews the previewUrl and presses "Sync to live"; use it when the human asked to see changes before they go out. Fails with page_not_found if the id is not a live or offline page in this space, and with secrets_detected (nothing changes) if the new content looks like it holds live credentials.

draft.description: Default false (publishes live instantly). true = stage the update; relay the returned previewUrl so the human can review and press Sync. A new draft replaces any pending one.

html.description: The complete new document (not a diff). HTML, or Markdown when source_type is "markdown".

page_id.description: The page id: the `id` field from publish_page or list_pages (also the last path segment of the page URL, …/docs/<page_id>). Only pages in the connected maker's space are visible.

project.description: Optional; omit to keep the existing project.

title.description: Optional; omit to keep the existing title.

name: update_page
title: Replace a page's content
